basic_info.description: 2 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $135,850; 4 = $149,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 5/29/24. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 6/20/24 at 5:00 PM. Open Houses: 6/7/24 @5-7 pm, 6/8/24 @ 12-2 pm, 6/9/24 @ 12-2 pm.
